pricing_schedule_id.description: PlatformPricingSchedule record this exact price belongs to.

pricing_item_key.description: Stable unique item key within the pricing schedule, such as launch_2026:trainer_business_growth_monthly:plan_monthly.

platform_plan_id.description: PlatformPlan record this price applies to, when the item is plan-related.

plan_key_snapshot.description: Copied PlatformPlan plan_key retained for readable pricing history.

platform_billing_rate_id.description: PlatformBillingRate record this price is based on, when the item is a registration, reactivation, overage, or other billing rate.

billing_rate_key_snapshot.description: Copied PlatformBillingRate rate_key retained for readable pricing history.

feature_key.description: Optional PlatformFeature key for an add-on or capacity-related price.

charge_model.description: How this exact scheduled price is billed.

amount_cents.description: Locked unit amount in cents for this pricing schedule item.

is_active.description: Controls whether this item may be used for accounts assigned to this pricing schedule.

effective_at.description: When this price becomes available within its pricing schedule.

ends_at.description: When this item stops being available, if replaced within the same draft schedule.

notes.description: Internal pricing notes, including grandfathering or special terms.
